hooks.command: bash -c 'echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; cmd=json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"command\",\"\"); exit(1 if (\"rm -rf\" in cmd and \"taxonomy\" in cmd) or (\"psql\" in cmd and (\"INSERT\" in cmd or \"UPDATE\" in cmd or \"DELETE\" in cmd)) else 0)"'
hooks.message: Blocked: direct rm -rf on taxonomy/ or direct psql writes are not allowed. Use migrations and taxonomy PRs.

hooks.command: bash -c 'echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; path=json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"file_path\",\"\"); exit(0 if \"taxonomy/\" not in path or not path.endswith(\".yaml\") else 1)" && exit 0 || node packages/shared/src/taxonomy/validate.mjs'
